name: Audit Trail User authentication events
description: Chains user-authentication events (login, logout, failed login, password reset requested/probed/used, block/unblock, account create/delete, password/role change) into the audit trail.
project_description: Submodule of audit_trail. Bridges the security-relevant lifecycle of an account session into the chained audit trail on channel audit_trail_user_auth (claimed by its own chain entity). Verbs: login and password_reset_used (hook_user_login, split by the user.reset.login route), logout, login_failed (a last-position login-form validate handler, logging the submitted name against user:anonymous), password_reset_requested vs password_reset_probed (a user_pass submit handler splitting on whether an account resolved: probe stream is the classic enumeration signal, logged at WARNING), account_blocked/_unblocked and password_changed and role_changed (hook_user_update diffs), account_created (user_insert) and account_deleted (user_delete). No password material is ever recorded: only the action verb and, for reset/failed-login, the typed identifier for enumeration triage. Every event is per-event opt-in via audit_trail_user_auth.settings:events. The base audit_trail module supplies the tamper-evidence.
